SELECT ur.*, u.*
FROM user_roles ur 
INNER JOIN users u on ur.user_id = u.id
WHERE ur.role_id = '{{ $json.query.role_id }}'
ORDER BY u.id

SELECT rp.*, p.*
FROM role_permissions rp 
INNER JOIN permissions p on rp.permission_id = p.id
WHERE rp.role_id = '{{ $json.query.role_id }}'
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT DISTINCT
    u.*
FROM
    public.users AS u
INNER JOIN
    public.user_roles AS ur ON u.id = ur.user_id
INNER JOIN
    public.role_permissions AS rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id
WHERE
    rp.permission_id = '{{ $json.query.permission_id }}'
ORDER BY u.id

SELECT
  t.*,
  u.name AS changed_by_name,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM audit_log t
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.changed_by
WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR t.table_name = $1)
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR t.operation = $2)
  AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR t.changed_by = $3)
  AND ($4::timestamp IS NULL OR t.changed_at >= $4::timestamp)
  AND ($5::timestamp IS NULL OR t.changed_at <= $5::timestamp)
ORDER BY {{ $json.orderColumn }} {{ $json.orderDirection }}, t.id DESC
LIMIT $6
OFFSET $7;
SELECT DISTINCT table_name FROM audit_log ORDER BY table_name;

-- record_id se guarda como texto JSON (p.ej. '{"id": 104778}') para las tablas
-- auditadas por el trigger generico de PK simple 'id'; el CASE soporta también
-- un record_id de texto plano por si alguna tabla no sigue ese formato.
SELECT
  t.*,
  u.name AS changed_by_name,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM audit_log t
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.changed_by
WHERE t.table_name = $1
  AND (CASE WHEN t.record_id LIKE '{%' THEN (t.record_id::jsonb ->> 'id') ELSE t.record_id END) = $2
ORDER BY t.changed_at DESC, t.id DESC
LIMIT $3
OFFSET $4;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.query.start_date}}'::DATE AS start_date,
        '{{ $json.query.end_date}}'::DATE AS end_date
),

-- CTE to calculate all KPI data. Each metric is calculated in its own subquery for clarity.
kpi_data AS (
    SELECT
        -- Metric 1: Revenue & Data for Average Revenue per Patient
        (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS current_period_revenue,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public.orders WHERE created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS current_active_patients,
        (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS previous_period_revenue,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public.orders WHERE created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS previous_active_patients,

        -- Metric 2: Sales
        (SELECT SUM(q.total) FROM public.orders o JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id WHERE o.created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS current_period_sales,
        (SELECT SUM(q.total) FROM public.orders o JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id WHERE o.created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS previous_period_sales,

        -- Metric 3: New Patients
        (SELECT COUNT(u.id)
        	FROM public.users u
        	INNER JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
        	INNER JOIN public.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id
        	WHERE r.name = 'paciente' AND u.is_active IS TRUE
        		AND u.created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS current_period_new_patients,
        (SELECT COUNT(u.id)
        	FROM public.users u
        	INNER JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
        	INNER JOIN public.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id
        	WHERE r.name = 'paciente' AND u.is_active IS TRUE
        		AND u.created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS previous_period_new_patients,

        -- Metric 4: Data for Quote Conversion Rate
        (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM public.quotes WHERE created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS quotes_created_current_period,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT quote_id) FROM public.orders WHERE quote_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS orders_created_current_period,
        (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM public.quotes WHERE created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS quotes_created_previous_period,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT quote_id) FROM public.orders WHERE quote_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS orders_created_previous_period,

        -- Metric 5: Data for Sales Trend
        (SELECT SUM(q.total) FROM public.orders o JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id WHERE date_trunc('month', o.created_at) = date_trunc('month', p.end_date)) AS sales_current_month_for_trend,
        (SELECT SUM(q.total) FROM public.orders o JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id WHERE date_trunc('month', o.created_at) = date_trunc('month', p.end_date - INTERVAL '1 month')) AS sales_previous_month_for_trend,
        
        -- Metric 6: Data for Appointment Show Rate
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.order_items WHERE scheduled_date::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) AS current_total_scheduled,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.order_items WHERE scheduled_date::DATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND LOWER(status) = 'completed') AS current_attended,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.order_items WHERE scheduled_date::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1)) AS previous_total_scheduled,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.order_items WHERE scheduled_date::DATE BETWEEN (p.start_date - (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1)) AND (p.start_date - 1) AND LOWER(status) = 'completed') AS previous_attended
    FROM
        params p
),

-- CTE to calculate the conversion rates before the final select
conversion_rates AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (CASE WHEN quotes_created_current_period IS NULL OR quotes_created_current_period = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (orders_created_current_period::NUMERIC / quotes_created_current_period::NUMERIC) END) AS current_rate,
        (CASE WHEN quotes_created_previous_period IS NULL OR quotes_created_previous_period = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (orders_created_previous_period::NUMERIC / quotes_created_previous_period::NUMERIC) END) AS previous_rate
    FROM kpi_data
)

-- Final calculation and selection of all KPIs and their growth percentages.
SELECT
    -- Revenue KPIs
    COALESCE(current_period_revenue, 0)::NUMERIC AS current_period_revenue,
    (CASE WHEN previous_period_revenue IS NULL OR previous_period_revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((current_period_revenue - previous_period_revenue) / previous_period_revenue) * 100, 2) END)::NUMERIC AS revenue_growth_percentage,

    -- Sales KPIs
    COALESCE(current_period_sales, 0)::NUMERIC AS current_period_sales,
    (CASE WHEN previous_period_sales IS NULL OR previous_period_sales = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((current_period_sales - previous_period_sales) / previous_period_sales) * 100, 2) END)::NUMERIC AS sales_growth_percentage,

    -- New Patients KPIs
    COALESCE(current_period_new_patients, 0)::INTEGER AS current_period_new_patients,
    (CASE WHEN previous_period_new_patients IS NULL OR previous_period_new_patients = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((current_period_new_patients::NUMERIC - previous_period_new_patients::NUMERIC) / previous_period_new_patients::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) END)::NUMERIC AS new_patients_growth_percentage,

    -- Quote Conversion Rate KPIs
    ROUND(current_rate * 100, 2)::NUMERIC AS quote_conversion_rate,
    (CASE WHEN previous_rate IS NULL OR previous_rate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((current_rate - previous_rate) / previous_rate) * 100, 2) END)::NUMERIC AS quote_conversion_rate_growth,

    -- Sales Trend KPI for the chart
    (CASE WHEN sales_previous_month_for_trend IS NULL OR sales_previous_month_for_trend = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((COALESCE(sales_current_month_for_trend, 0) - sales_previous_month_for_trend) / sales_previous_month_for_trend) * 100, 2) END)::NUMERIC AS sales_trend_percentage,

    -- Average Revenue per Patient KPIs
    (CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_active_patients, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(current_period_revenue, 0) / current_active_patients END)::NUMERIC AS average_revenue_per_patient,
    (
        (CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_active_patients, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(current_period_revenue, 0) / current_active_patients END) -
        (CASE WHEN COALESCE(previous_active_patients, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(previous_period_revenue, 0) / previous_active_patients END)
    )::NUMERIC AS avg_revenue_change_vs_previous,

    -- Appointment Show Rate KPIs
    (CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_total_scheduled, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (current_attended::NUMERIC * 100 / current_total_scheduled) END)::NUMERIC AS show_rate_percentage,
    (
        (CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_total_scheduled, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (current_attended::NUMERIC * 100 / current_total_scheduled) END) -
        (CASE WHEN COALESCE(previous_total_scheduled, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (previous_attended::NUMERIC * 100 / previous_total_scheduled) END)
    )::NUMERIC AS show_rate_change_vs_previous
FROM
    conversion_rates;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT '{{ $json.query.target_date}}'::DATE AS target_date
),

-- CTE to generate a series of the first day of all 12 months for the target year.
-- This ensures that every month is present in the final result, even if it has no sales.
year_months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('year', p.target_date),
        date_trunc('year', p.target_date) + INTERVAL '11 months',
        '1 month'
    )::DATE AS month_start
    FROM params p
),

-- CTE to calculate the actual total sales per month from your database.
-- Sales are calculated from quotes linked to orders created within each month.
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.created_at)::DATE AS month_start,
        SUM(q.total) AS total_sales
    FROM
        public.orders o
    JOIN
        public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT target_date FROM params))
    GROUP BY
        1
)

-- Final SELECT statement to join the generated months with the actual sales data.
-- A LEFT JOIN ensures all months appear. COALESCE handles months with no sales.
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(ym.month_start, 'Mon') AS month, -- Formats the month to a 3-letter abbreviation (e.g., 'Jan')
    COALESCE(ms.total_sales, 0)::NUMERIC AS revenue -- Uses 0 if a month had no sales. Using 'sales' as the key.
FROM
    year_months ym
LEFT JOIN
    monthly_sales ms ON ym.month_start = ms.month_start
ORDER BY
    ym.month_start;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.query.start_date}}'::DATE AS start_date,
        '{{ $json.query.end_date}}'::DATE AS end_date
)

-- Main query to calculate sales per service.
SELECT
    sc.name AS name,
    SUM(qi.total)::NUMERIC AS sales
FROM
    public.orders o
-- Join through quotes and quote_items to link an order to its specific services
JOIN
    public.quote_items qi ON o.quote_id = qi.quote_id
JOIN
    public.service_catalog sc ON qi.service_id = sc.id
WHERE
    -- Filter orders to the specified date range
    o.created_at::DATE BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM params) AND (SELECT end_date FROM params)
GROUP BY
    sc.id, sc.name -- Group by service to sum up all sales for that service
ORDER BY
    sales DESC -- Order by total sales to find the top performing services
LIMIT 5;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 30 AS overdue_days_threshold -- An invoice is considered overdue after 30 days.
),

-- CTE to classify every invoice into a specific category based on its status and age.
classified_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            -- If the invoice is paid (case-insensitive), its status is 'Paid'.
            WHEN LOWER(status) = 'paid' THEN 'Paid'
            
            -- If the invoice is unpaid (case-insensitive) and its creation date is older than the threshold, it's 'Overdue'.
            WHEN LOWER(status) = 'unpaid' AND created_at < (CURRENT_DATE - (SELECT overdue_days_threshold FROM params) * INTERVAL '1 day') THEN 'Overdue'
            
            -- If the invoice is unpaid (case-insensitive) but not yet overdue, it's 'Pending'.
            WHEN LOWER(status) = 'unpaid' THEN 'Pending'

            -- Any other status (e.g., 'voided', 'cancelled') can be grouped as 'Other'.
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS status_category
    FROM
        public.invoices
),

-- CTE to aggregate the counts for each status category.
aggregated_status AS (
    SELECT
        status_category,
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS invoice_count
    FROM
        classified_invoices
    GROUP BY
        status_category
)

-- Final SELECT to format the output exactly as required by the pie chart component.
SELECT
    status_category AS name,
    invoice_count AS value,
    CASE status_category
        WHEN 'Paid'    THEN 'hsl(var(--chart-1))'
        WHEN 'Overdue' THEN 'hsl(var(--destructive))'
        WHEN 'Pending' THEN 'hsl(var(--chart-2))'
        ELSE 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))'
    END AS fill
FROM
    aggregated_status
ORDER BY
    -- Order the results logically for display consistency.
    CASE status_category
        WHEN 'Overdue' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Paid'    THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.query.start_date}}'::DATE AS start_date,
        '{{ $json.query.end_date}}'::DATE AS end_date
),

active_patients_in_period AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        user_id
    FROM
        public.orders
    WHERE
        created_at::DATE BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM params) AND (SELECT end_date FROM params)
)

-- Final SELECT to classify and count the patients.
SELECT
    -- Count users whose creation date is WITHIN the period (New Patients)
    COUNT(CASE WHEN u.created_at::DATE >= p.start_date THEN 1 END)::INTEGER AS new_patients,

    -- Count users whose creation date is BEFORE the period (Recurring Patients)
    COUNT(CASE WHEN u.created_at::DATE < p.start_date THEN 1 END)::INTEGER AS recurring_patients
FROM
    active_patients_in_period ap
JOIN
    public.users u ON ap.user_id = u.id
CROSS JOIN
    params p;

WITH resultados AS (
    SELECT id, nombre_generico, nombre_comercial
    FROM public.catalogo_medicamentos
    WHERE (
        $1 IS NULL 
        OR $1 = '' 
        OR nombre_generico ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
        OR nombre_comercial ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
),
conteo AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS total_items FROM resultados
)
SELECT 
    r.*, 
    c.total_items,
    CEIL(c.total_items::float / $2) AS total_pages
FROM resultados r, conteo c
ORDER BY r.id
LIMIT $2 
OFFSET ($3 - 1) * $2;
